name: 聚类类别在后续表格/叙述中无版本说明地改名或换组
trigger: objects are assigned to one cluster/type scheme, then later tables use different type labels without a new clustering/taxonomy rule
example: S043 Table 6.4 cluster memberships vs Table 6.6 garden-type labels
gate: all cluster/type labels carry taxonomy_id/run_id; downstream summaries join by that registry rather than retyping labels
